page.layout: One column of text, full width, under a printed ornamental border at the top. No marginal notes. Faint show-through from the other side of the leaf is not transcribed.

main_text.l: FABRITI nostræ quondam pars maxima mentis,

l.i: Nec nunc diviso corpore, crede, minor!
Ut veniens à Te me nuper epistola grata,
Et multum votis ante petita meis.
Illa ut me docuit specimen Te grande laboris,
Auctusq; in studiis edere velle Tui.
Exilii, in tales os solüiq; sonos.

main_text.l: Non tam quantum nos, sed quantū intellegat
ipse, Notum facundo cuilibet ore facit.

page.notes: Large initial F in "FABRITI" and "FABRITIUS" is a decorated capital, joined to the following word. The "Auctusq;" and "solüiq;" forms are as printed. Long s rendered as plain s throughout. The verse lines are kept on separate lines within each stanza paragraph.
